ptOkdJqu4P0.desc:
Boy Wonder's World is a BTS look at the life of Miami HEAT guard, Tyler Herro, during the NBA season and offseason.

After getting off to hot start this season, Tyler went down with an ankle injury during a game in Memphis. In this episode you'll see Tyler getting treatment, going to an ankle specialist, spending time with family at his home in Miami, and working hard to get back on the court as soon as possible.

To see more of Boy Wonder's life, check out:
Tik Tok: @tylerherro
Instagram: @nolimitherro
Twitter: @raf_tyler

Music produced by Danny Alexopoulos
ptOkdJqu4P0.title: Boy Wonder's World: Episode 1 -- Tyler Herro Rehabbing from Injury
